Official overview (JSON-LD / property description)
Experience the dynamic energy of Bangkok from Ascott Sathorn Bangkok, your sophisticated residence in the city's bustling Sathorn district. This prime location places you directly on South Sathorn Road, providing an unrivalled base for both commerce and exploration. The residence is positioned just a short stroll, approximately 300 metres, from the St. Louis BTS Skytrain station, ensuring seamless urban access. From here, the vibrant shopping and renowned nightlife districts of Silom Road are only a brief drive away, offering endless opportunities for sophisticated leisure and engagement. Our serviced apartments provide a convenient and prestigious platform to discover Bangkok's unique blend of modern marvels and rich cultural heritage.

Our luxury residence offers a selection of spacious and elegantly furnished apartments, ranging from comfortable studios to expansive three-bedroom layouts, designed to cater to the needs of the global traveller. Each apartment is appointed with contemporary pieces, creating an inviting atmosphere for sophisticated urban living. Guests benefit from en-suite bathrooms, a fully equipped modern kitchenette for personalised meal preparation, and the highly valued convenience of in-apartment washing machines and dryers, ensuring a comfortable and independent extended stay.

Ascott Sathorn Bangkok provides an extensive array of exclusive facilities and signature services to enhance your residential experience. Maintain your fitness routine at our modern fitness centre, or take a refreshing dip in the outdoor swimming pool. For relaxation, enjoy the soothing Jacuzzi, sauna, and steam rooms. For our executive guests, dedicated meeting and conference rooms are available, alongside a residents' lounge, perfect for socialising or quiet reflection. Families will appreciate the dedicated children's wading pool and the engaging Cubbies' Kids Club. We also feature specialist services, such as Fitfac Muaythai Academy and FlexFirst Physio, that cater comprehensively to your wellness needs.

Beyond the exceptional amenities, our dedicated team offers a range of services designed for absolute convenience. Daily breakfast and meal delivery services are available via our on-site dining options, including Melly Restaurant and CARP Restaurant. We provide essential services, including airport transfers, laundry and dry cleaning, and a professional concierge to assist with your requests. The property is smoke-free and features electric vehicle charging stations for guests. Our commitment to your well-being is further underscored by 24/7 on-call wellness and security services, which ensure peace of mind.

Official apartment hub (Serviced Apartments in Bangkok, Thailand)
At the end of a long day out and about, retire to the luxury residence to rejuvenate. Ascott Sathorn Bangkok offers our global travellers the comforts and little lavishes that makes us their home of choice away from home.


The serviced apartments are spacious and elegantly furnished with contemporary furniture, encapsulating the very idea of sophisticated global living. Apartments come in various sizes, ranging from studios to three-bedroom apartments that come fitted with a well-equipped kitchenette for those who enjoy preparing their own meals, and a washing machine & dryer.


In addition, each apartment is fitted with a television complete with a home entertainment system, en-suite bathrooms, a workstation when business beckons, individually controlled air-conditioning, housekeeping service, and complimentary Wi-Fi connectivity.

Official location
Ascott Sathorn Bangkok is ideally situated in the vibrant Sathorn district, a prominent area known for its blend of bustling business activity and engaging leisure pursuits. Our luxury residence sits squarely on South Sathorn Road, offering you immediate access to the pulse of this multifaceted metropolis. The surrounding area provides a sophisticated backdrop for your stay, featuring charming local eateries and cultural landmarks. For those exploring by foot, the iconic King Power Mahanakhon, with its impressive SkyWalk, is just a 3-minute walk from our doorstep, offering panoramic city vistas. Furthermore, Lumphini Park, a peaceful green oasis perfect for a morning jog or a leisurely afternoon, is a pleasant 10-15-minute walk away.

The location offers unparalleled access to Bangkok's key leisure and cultural attractions. The renowned nightlife and shopping districts along Silom Road are just a brief drive or a few convenient BTS stops away. From our central location, you can easily visit significant cultural treasures such as the Grand Palace, Wat Pho, and Wat Arun, often accessible via the Chao Phraya River's water taxis. For a unique retail experience, the expansive Chatuchak Weekend Market is also well within reach, accessible via a direct BTS journey. Our prime position ensures you are supremely well-connected to all that Bangkok has to offer.

Official FAQ
Q: What types of serviced apartments are available at Ascott Sathorn Bangkok?
A: Ascott Sathorn Bangkok offers a range of spacious serviced apartments, from studios to three-bedroom units, all elegantly furnished for your comfort and convenience.
Q: Is Ascott Sathorn Bangkok suitable for short stays?
A: Yes, Ascott Sathorn Bangkok is ideal for both short and long stays, offering fully equipped apartments with kitchenettes, washing machines, and comprehensive services to ensure a comfortable and independent experience.
Q: Is there housekeeping service?
A: Yes, we offer housekeeping 3 times a week.
Q: Does Ascott Sathorn Bangkok have airport transportation?
A: Yes, Ascott Sathorn Bangkok offers airport transportation for guests. Guests can select the airport transfer option during the booking process on our website.
Q: What are the facilities available at Ascott Sathorn Bangkok?
A: Some of the more popular amenities offered at Ascott Sathorn Bangkok include Free Wi-Fi, Swimming Pool, Children Play Room, Fitness Center, Residence Lounge and Resturants.
Q: Is there car parking available at Ascott Sathorn Bangkok?
A: Yes, car parking is available at Ascott Sathorn Bangkok. Complimentary for In-House guest and Carpark rental THB 3,300 per month.
Q: What popular attractions are close to Ascott Sathorn Bangkok?
A: Guests at Ascott Sathorn Bangkok can easily visit Mahanakorn Building located in the Sathorn area.
Q: How do I get to Ascott Sathorn Bangkok?
A: Ascott Sathorn Bangkok is easy to access from BTS Saint Louise station.
Q: How close is Ascott Sathorn Bangkok to public transport?
A: Ascott Sathorn Bangkok is exceptionally well-located, just a short walk of approximately 300 metres from the St. Louis BTS Skytrain station, providing excellent connectivity across Bangkok.

Official overview (JSON-LD / property description)
Somerset Sukhumvit Thonglor Bangkok offers a refined home in the heart of the city, perfectly positioned on Sukhumvit Road. This serviced residence places you within easy reach of Bangkok's dynamic energy, from bustling shopping districts to cultural landmarks. The vibrant Thonglor neighbourhood, known for its fashionable restaurants, trendy cafés, and lively nightlife, is right on your doorstep and is often referred to as 'Little Japan' due to its diverse culinary scene and expatriate community. You will find convenience in every direction, with excellent accessibility to explore all that Bangkok has to offer.

Each spacious apartment at Somerset Sukhumvit Thonglor Bangkok is thoughtfully designed for comfort and practicality, providing a welcoming sanctuary after a day of city exploration or business. Guests can enjoy separate living and dining areas, perfect for relaxation or entertaining. Every apartment features a flat-screen television for entertainment, an en-suite bathroom for privacy, and a well-equipped kitchenette complete with a washer and dryer, ensuring a seamless stay for both short and extended visits. A dedicated workstation is also provided for those who need to attend to business while travelling.

The residence provides a comprehensive array of facilities and services designed to enhance your stay. Start your day with a delicious breakfast at The Restaurant, offering a range of culinary delights. Maintain your fitness routine at our modern fitness centre, or take a refreshing dip in the outdoor swimming pool, complete with a relaxing jacuzzi. Families will appreciate the Cubbies' Kids Club, a complimentary children's club offering engaging activities for younger guests. For business needs, Regus Office Space offers professional meeting facilities.

Your comfort and peace of mind are paramount, with 24/7 on-call wellness and security services, including a 24-hour front desk and CCTV surveillance. The property is also accessible, ensuring a comfortable experience for all guests. Additional amenities include complimentary Wi-Fi throughout the residence, laundry and dry cleaning services, and a residents' lounge, offering a cosy space to socialise or simply relax. Guests can also enjoy the sauna and steam rooms, providing a perfect way to rejuvenate. Experience a lifestyle where every detail is considered, allowing you to live your way in Bangkok truly.

Official summary
To experience the vibrant energy of one of the world's most colourful and populated cities, one should pay Bangkok a visit. It is here where climate-controlled mega-malls sit alongside 200-year-old villages, and where iconic tuk-tuks zip in and out of lanes precariously. The city’s multifaceted personality is what gives it its allure - that while the city races alongside its South East Asian neighbours towards urbanisation, it romantically holds dearly onto its rich culture, heritage and history.

It is in the very heart of this booming metropolis where Somerset Sukhumvit Thonglor Bangkok lies. The serviced residence sits squarely on Sukhumvit Road, just 10-minute away from BTS Thonglor skytrain. A complimentary tuk-tuk service from the residence to the train station will be available for all Somerset guests. The residence is also within a walking distance to the renowned nightlife and cafes along Thonglor Road. The residence is also a mere hour-long drive to both the Suvarnabhumi International Airport and Don Muang Airport.

Official apartment hub (Hotel Near Thonglor)
Somerset Sukhumvit Thonglor provides the convenience and comfort of a serviced residence. Its well-appointed residences range from cleverly designed studios optimised for comfort to beautiful 2-bedroom apartments designed for solo travellers, small groups of friends, couples and even families. Apartments are also fitted with a well-equipped kitchenette with washer and dryer, separate living and dining areas, en suite bathrooms with shower and bathtub along with eco-friendly bath amenities, wide balcony windows boasting impressive views of the Thai capital.

Other room amenities include an LCD television connected to a steam iron and ironing board, a workstation for when work beckons as well as air-conditioning. Wi-Fi connectivity and housekeeping services are also available.

Official location
Somerset Sukhumvit Thonglor Bangkok enjoys a prime location in the heart of the city, directly on Sukhumvit Road in the vibrant Thonglor neighbourhood (Sukhumvit Soi 55). This sought-after address is renowned for its sophisticated charm and lively atmosphere, celebrated for its fashionable restaurants, inviting cafés, and diverse nightlife. You will find an eclectic mix of culinary experiences and unique boutiques just steps from the property. For high-end retail therapy, the upscale Emquartier and Emporium malls are easily accessible, typically requiring a short 5-minute BTS ride from the nearby station.

The area provides unparalleled convenience for both professional and leisure pursuits. The BTS Thong Lo Skytrain station is conveniently located just a 10-minute walk from the residence, providing a quick and efficient way to reach central business districts and popular attractions across Bangkok. This strategic setting ensures effortless connectivity to the entire metropolis, simplifying your daily commute and sightseeing plans.

Official FAQ
Q: What type of accommodation does Somerset Sukhumvit Thonglor Bangkok offer?
A: Somerset Sukhumvit Thonglor Bangkok provides luxury serviced apartments, ideal for both short and long stays in the city. Each apartment features separate living and dining areas, a well-equipped kitchenette, and modern amenities for your comfort.
Q: Are the apartments suitable for long stays in Bangkok?
A: Absolutely. Our serviced apartments are designed with long-stay guests in mind, featuring fully equipped kitchenettes with a washer and dryer, separate living areas, and dedicated workstations, providing all the comforts of home for an extended visit to Bangkok.
Q: What is the smoking policy at Somerset Sukhumvit Thonglor Bangkok?
A: Somerset Sukhumvit Thonglor Bangkok does not permit smoking in non-smoking areas but allows smoking in smoking areas.
Q: How much is an extra bed?
A: The extra bed is 900THB/bed/night for all room types.
Q: Does Somerset Sukhumvit Thonglor Bangkok have airport transportation?
A: Yes, Somerset Sukhumvit Thonglor Bangkok offers airport transportation for guests. Guests can select the airport transfer option during the booking process on our website.
Q: Is there housekeeping service?
A: Yes, we offer housekeeping service daily, weekly, or three times a week.
Q: What amenities are available for guests at Somerset Sukhumvit Thonglor Bangkok?
A: Guests can enjoy a range of amenities, including an outdoor swimming pool, jacuzzi, fitness centre, The Restaurant for breakfast, Cubbies' Kids Club, Lobby Lounge, and Regus Office Space. We also offer 24/7 security and accessible facilities.
Q: Is breakfast service available at the residence?
A: Yes, The Restaurant at Somerset Sukhumvit Thonglor Bangkok offers a delightful breakfast service for guests to start their day.
Q: How do I get to Somerset Sukhumvit Thonglor Bangkok?
A: Somerset Sukhumvit Thonglor Bangkok is easy to access by Taxi and also close to BTS Thonglor station, only a 10-minute walk.
Q: What popular attractions are close to Somerset Sukhumvit Thonglor Bangkok?
A: Guests at Somerset Sukhumvit Thonglor Bangkok can easily visit the Thonglor area in the Sukhumvit Soi 55.
Q: How far is Somerset Sukhumvit Thonglor Bangkok from public transport?
A: The residence is conveniently located just a 10-minute walk from the BTS Thong Lo Skytrain station. A complimentary tuk-tuk service is also available to take guests to the station and selected shopping centres.
Q: What can I expect from the Thonglor neighbourhood around the hotel?
A: The Thonglor neighbourhood is known for its trendy and vibrant atmosphere, offering an array of fashionable restaurants, cafés, and lively nightlife. It is also recognised as 'Little Japan' due to its strong Japanese expatriate community and authentic culinary scene.

A pre-revolution Cuban cocktail bar hidden away in a by-lane directly opposite the hotel. Dim lighting, exposed beams, crumbling plaster, and classic Cuba Libre and other cocktails.

MADAME TUSSAUDS (10 mins by BTS)
Get up close with some of the famous (and infamous) personalities from the past and present at this Bangkok edition.

One of Southeast Asia’s largest aquariums, featuring attractions such as shark tunnels, a glass-bottomed boat, penguin shows, and 4D cinema experiences.

Guranteed feast for the senses at the centre of Bangkok’s Chinatown, with a wide variety of  restaurants and street food vendors to choose from.

Recently opened as one of Bangkok’s largest parks, a city-centre wilderness of wetlands with footpaths and an elevated walkway.

Running alongside one of Bangkok’s oldest canals, which has recently been restored, this is a delightful weekend night market.

FRASER INSIDER

THE ERAWAN SHRINE
Blessing tips, the four-faced Buddha
1st face North side (street-facing) : For seeking blessings on work, study, promotion, power and prestige and matters related to fatherhood.  The offerings are 16 incense sticks, 9 candles, 9 lotus flowers and a bottle of water.
2nd face East side: For blessings on material assets such as houses, cars, land, including money or debts that have been borrowed and not returned. There are 36 incense sticks, 9 candles, 9 lotus flowers and a bottle of water.
3rd face South side: For blessings relating to family and health. There are 39 incense sticks, 9 candles, 9 lotus flowers and a bottle of water.
4th face West side: Paying homage to money, fortune, luck and for children with 19 incense sticks, 9 candles, 9 lotus flowers and a bottle of water.
HAVANA SOCIAL
To find pre-revolution Cuba in Bangkok, you’ll need to zig-zag to the back end of Sukhumvit Soi 11.  At the far end of the lane, make a sharp turn and immediately arrive at a quieter residential district.where a faded mural is adjacent to a phonebooth and a bouncer. The phone is broken, so use your personal phone to call for the code; then, punch in the code and push open the doors. Inside, the walls are crumbling, the lights are dim, laundry is hanging out to dry, fedoras are hanging on the wall, and the salsa band is in full force. Welcome to Cuba.
THE GINGERBREAD HOUSE
Within a minute or two on foot from the Giant Swing, the Gingerbread House takes its name from the gingerbread style of architecture that first appeared in the mid-19th century. This house was built in 1913, and remains original. Now a museum, the house is also a charming cafe.

A "Do You Know?" moment.  Experience the destination like a local.

BEYOND THE NEIGHBOURHOOD

BANG NAM PHEUNG FLOATING MARKET
The charm of the market is that it sits alongside a canal in the heart of this semi-rural Thai Mon community, located inside a huge undeveloped loop in the river that forms an important green lung for the city. On sale from local residents are handicrafts, garments, fruit, dried shrimp and fish, desserts, and wonderful traditional street food.
CHATUCHAK MARKET
Reputedly the largest indoor and outdoor market in the world, covering over 35 acres, housing 27 sections, Chatuchak Market sells just about everything.  Take the BTS to Mo Chit or the MRT to Chatuchak Park Station.
TALAD ROM HUP OR MAEKLONG RAILWAY MARKET
The name actually means Closing Umbrella Market, because the trains of the Maeklong Railway pass right into the market within inches of the vendors and their goods, causing those closest to the line to fold their sunshades. The market can be reached by car, or delightfully by catching a train from Wongwian Yai railway station on Thonburi-side.
